style: Photorealistic cinematic image, vertical 2:3 portrait. Dramatic high-contrast lighting, rich shadows, shallow depth of field, film grain. Main subject in the upper 60% of the frame; the bottom 35% must be darker and visually calm (space for a headline added later). Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere. No real celebrities. No nudity.

covers.002-marco-aurelio: A weathered white marble bust of a bearded Roman emperor with a fine crack running across his face, lit by a single warm light from the side against a pitch black background, dust particles floating.
covers.003-dominio-proprio: A calm man in a dark tailored suit standing still while holding a heavy chain leash of a huge snarling black wolf at his side, foggy night street, wet cobblestones, cold blue light.
covers.004-seneca-tempo: A human skeleton wearing an elegant black suit and tie, sitting at an old wooden desk, looking at a gold pocket watch in its bony hand, single desk lamp, dark study room, unsettling but classy.
covers.005-epicteto: Close-up of strong male hands breaking free from heavy rusty iron chains, chain links snapping and flying, sparks and dust, dark dungeon background, dramatic rim light.
covers.006-sun-tzu: An ancient Chinese general in lacquered armor standing on a misty hilltop at dawn, looking down over a vast army in the valley, red banners, epic scale, cinematic.
covers.007-respeito: A stunning elegant woman in a fitted red evening dress sitting at a candle-lit restaurant table, looking with admiration at a well-dressed man in a dark suit seen from behind in the foreground, warm moody light, tasteful and classy.
covers.008-disciplina: A muscular shirtless man doing heavy dumbbell training alone in a dark underground gym at 5am, sweat glistening, single overhead light, intense focus, gritty atmosphere.
covers.009-amizades: A man in a casual shirt with an exaggerated, unsettling fake wide smile and cold dead eyes, giving a thumbs up to the camera, dim greenish fluorescent office light, creepy uncanny portrait.
covers.010-adversidade: A lone man in a long dark coat walking against a violent storm on an empty coastal road, heavy rain and wind, lightning in the distance, seen from behind.
covers.011-confucio: Portrait of a wise elderly Chinese sage with a long white beard and traditional robes, sitting in an ancient wooden library with scrolls, warm candle light, deep serene gaze.
covers.012-raiva: Extreme close-up of a furious man's face, clenched jaw, veins on forehead, red skin, eyes burning with rage, dark background with red light, intense.
covers.013-musashi: A lone samurai in a dark kimono standing in heavy rain at night in a bamboo forest, hand on the hilt of his katana, lantern light, cinematic.
covers.014-lao-tzu: A calm man in a dark suit sitting perfectly still in meditation in the middle of a chaotic crowded city street at night, people blurred rushing around him, neon reflections.
covers.015-nietzsche: Dramatic black and white portrait of a stern 19th-century German philosopher with a huge thick mustache and intense deep-set eyes, high contrast, old photograph texture.
covers.016-maquiavel: A Renaissance king sitting on a golden throne in a dark hall, smiling slightly, hiding a dagger behind his back in his other hand, candles, oil painting lighting.
covers.017-autoconhecimento: A man in a white shirt standing in front of a bathroom mirror at night, but his reflection is a different, darker and older version of himself staring back, eerie cinematic.
covers.018-arena: A battered gladiator kneeling in the dust of a Roman arena, face dirty with sweat, dust and blood, crowd roaring in the blurred background, golden sunlight beams.
covers.019-acao: A young man lying on a couch in a dark room scrolling his phone, face lit by the screen, empty fast-food boxes around, while through the window behind him another man runs in the sunrise.
covers.020-mudanca: A man standing alone under a single street lamp in the rain at night, looking up at the sky as the clouds begin to open, first light breaking through, hopeful mood.
